input.prompt:
Maya, a woman in her late twenties, South Asian, olive skin, no makeup, faint under-eye shadows, dark wavy hair in a messy bun with loose wisps. Same in every shot: oversized cobalt-blue crewneck sweatshirt, charcoal leggings, white sneakers, plain dark smartwatch on her left wrist with a matte black unlit face. Her hands are empty.
Street: SoHo cobblestones, red brick buildings, blank unlettered awnings, plain closed shutters, wet asphalt, flat overcast daylight, neutral white balance.
Look: wide-normal lens, camera fixed on sticks, no camera movement, one continuous shot, documentary realism, visible skin texture, fine grain. Muted grey and brick, Maya the only saturated colour. Heads in the middle third, top and bottom of frame kept clear.
Rules: no text, letters, numerals, signage, logos or lit screens anywhere in frame. Maya does not talk to anyone. Exactly five strangers, and nobody enters or leaves frame except Maya.
The same fixed camera, the same cobblestone street, the same overcast light, the same five strangers standing in the same positions doing the same things: green flannel waving both palms forward, brown blazer raising one flat palm, grey beard shrugging with both hands turned up. Mouths moving constantly, no intelligible speech. Nothing has changed for them.
audio: the same dense unintelligible street murmur at the same level throughout, many overlapping voices, traffic, no music, never silent.
Maya walks straight through the middle of them toward camera without breaking stride or turning her head, while they keep talking at her from both sides. As she goes she turns her left wrist over for half a second, its face still matte black and unlit. As she comes close to camera the five behind her fall soft and out of focus.
Finally she stops close to camera, looks straight into the lens and breaks into a wide open grin, teeth showing, eyes creasing, and holds that grin, still looking into the lens, until the last frame.
